fact: The DPPD 2023-2025 of the Ministry of Digital Affairs budgets the Numérique programme, whose performance framework carries broadband and very high speed penetration indicators and the aim of covering the whole territory with high and very high speed internet.
title: DPPD 2023-2025 Ministère du Numérique et de la Digitalisation (035)
publisher: Ministère de l'Économie et des Finances (Bénin)
